verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS (plus HITRUST) as frameworks run in the same platform. Its auditor-built Unified Controls map all offered frameworks to a single core control list, so adding a new framework surfaces only the incremental action items rather than requiring a new tool. HIPAA has a framework-to-Unified-Control guide and templates; PCI DSS includes ASV scans and pentesting tied to controls; GDPR is pitched as an add-on to the multi-framework program. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and GDPR/PCI-specific control-mapping docs comparable to the HIPAA/SOC 2/HITRUST guides (GDPR evidence is marketing-level only).
